description: The crew walks the five-Knot science plan; a space weather watch comes 30 minutes before a solar particle event. At the alert the pressurised rover drives out to meet the astronaut on the route back, the astronaut boards, and the walk stops.

events.display_message: Marswalk started: five Knots planned, first stop Boxwork first view.
events.recommended_action: Follow the planned route and check tasks off at each Knot.

events.display_message: Space weather watch: solar flare seen. Radiation storm possible in about 30 min (est.).
events.recommended_action: Keep working near the route back; the rover is ready to drive out.

events.display_message: Solar storm: radiation rising fast. The rover is driving out to meet you.
events.recommended_action: Walk the route back now; board the rover where you meet.

events.display_message: Rover driving out to meet you; the science plan is stopped.
events.recommended_action: Keep walking the route back; board the rover when it arrives.
